findings.message: Param busca has effect filter:pessoasEquipe but no state holds it. Added public state 'busca' (string | null, persisted, loaded from URL/localStorage); qryPessoasEquipe(busca?, page, append) publishes it and sends it in the query input.

State selectedMembroEquipe (select:cadastroPessoa) has no setter and no request fetching the record. Added public selectCadastroPessoa(id|null), which also fills the edit draft, and a getter cadastroPessoa returning the row of the loaded list.

The commands have no '<command>.input' state. Added drafts cmdCadastrarPessoaDraft and cmdSalvarAlteracoesDraft (the latter prefilled from the selected row and refilled from the saved record) with setters setCmdCadastrarPessoaDraft and setCmdSalvarAlteracoesDraft.

cmdCadastrarPessoa returns a person that is upserted into pessoas.items (appended at the end when new), but the list is ordered by name and filtered by busca on the backend, so the new row may be out of order or not match the current search; pageStatus stays 'empty' if the list was empty before the first registration. Reload with qryPessoasEquipe() to realign.
